description: Search the services this chat can buy through Superstables: each one's id, what it returns, its price, the chain it is paid on, whether that chain is a testnet, and its inputs. A service with testnet false is paid on a mainnet. q matches words in the id, name and description; chain is a chain key or CAIP-2 id, such as arc, base-sepolia or eip155:5042, and an unknown chain is refused. Index listings come 20 at a time: for more, repeat the call with the same q and chain and next_cursor as cursor. Reads a public catalogue and moves no funds.

chain.description: A chain key or CAIP-2 id, such as "base-sepolia", "arc" or "eip155:5042"

q.description: Words to look for, such as "market data"

name: find_services
title: Find services to buy
